"Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."

transcript_tail:
Tool calls the agent made:
[step 1] shell "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$synth = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
$text = "Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."
$out = "<WORKSPACE>\announcement.wav"
$synth.SetOutputToWaveFile($out)
$synth.Speak($text)
$synth.Dispose()
Write-Output "done"" ok -> "done"
[step 1] shell "$f = Get-Item "<WORKSPACE>\announcement.wav"
Write-Output ("Size: " + $f.Length + " bytes")
# Parse WAV header for duration
$fs = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($f.FullName)
$br = New-Object System.IO.BinaryReader($fs)
$br.ReadBytes(12) | Out-Null
$br.ReadUInt32() | Out-Null
$br.ReadUInt16() | Out-Null
$channels = $br.ReadUInt16()
$sampleRate = $br.ReadUInt32()
$byteRate = $br.ReadUInt32()
$br.ReadUInt16() | Out-Null
$br.ReadUInt16() | Out-Null
$fs.Close()
$dataSize = $f.Length - 44
$duration = $dataSize / $byteRate
Write-Output ("Channels: " + $channels)
Write-Output ("SampleRate: " + $sampleRate)
Write-Output ("Duration: " + [math]::Round($duration,2) + " s")" ok -> "Size: 246034 bytes
Channels: 0
SampleRate: 65537
Duration: 11.16 s"
[step 1] shell "$f = Get-Item "<WORKSPACE>\announcement.wav"
$fs = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($f.FullName)
$br = New-Object System.IO.BinaryReader($fs)
$br.ReadBytes(12) | Out-Null   # RIFF size WAVE
$br.ReadUInt32() | Out-Null    # 'fmt '
$br.ReadUInt32() | Out-Null    # fmt chunk size
$fmt = $br.ReadUInt16()
$channels = $br.ReadUInt16()
$sampleRate = $br.ReadUInt32()
$byteRate = $br.ReadUInt32()
$blockAlign = $br.ReadUInt16()

$fs.Close()
$dataSize = $f.Length - 44
$duration = $dataSize / $byteRate
Write-Output ("fmt=$fmt ch=$channels rate=$sampleRate byteRate=$byteRate align=$blockAlign bits=$bits")
